title: 第11章唐三低头叫老大，不服输就把你阉了-《斗罗V：开局绑定朱竹清，创建神级家族》
content:
第(1/3)页

    【叮！恭喜宿主收小弟小舞，为家族增添成员。】

    【叮！系统绑定小舞成功，奖励祖龙血脉，获得魅惑之神（二级神祇）传承。】

    【注：祖龙血脉乃是斗罗大陆最强血脉，是所有龙族的始祖，地位在龙神之上。】

    【叮！恭喜宿主收到小舞反馈，第一枚魂环年限提升四百年，第二枚魂环提升七百年，魂力提升一级。】

    【叮！由于小舞的身份比较特殊，宿主可以在后期让小舞转变为婢女或兽宠身份。】

    【叮！鉴于朱竹清主动为宿主招揽小舞，为家族做出贡献，贡献值5%，宿主和朱竹清皆提升百分之五十的修行速度和体魄加成。】

    叶寒收到了系统的提示声，更加确定了小舞的身份。

    她果然不是人类，是一只兔子变的。

    但有了祖龙血脉的加持，应该能让小舞真心俯首称臣吧。

    “老大！”

    唐三见小舞都喊人了，抿了抿嘴，不甘心地喊了出来。

    为了小舞，他只能委曲求全。

    他今后一定找回面子，将叶寒击败，成为史莱克学院学生们的老大。

    【叮！恭喜宿主收小弟唐三，为家族增添成员。】

    【叮！系统绑定唐三成功，奖励主角气运之身，获得海神（一级神祇）和修罗神（神王）传承。】

    【注：主角气运之身为世界最强大的血脉之一，无论身处那个世界，都会变成主角，获得主角的全部气运和奇遇。】

    【叮！恭喜宿主收到唐三反馈，第一枚魂环年限提升四百年，第二枚魂环提升七百年，魂力提升一级。】

    【叮！鉴于唐三是斗罗大陆主角，希望宿主能将其奴役，为你所用。】

    【叮！朱竹清帮宿主招揽唐三，贡献值10%，宿主和朱竹清皆提升一倍的修行速度和体魄加成。】

    系统的提示声再次传来，让他看到了如何提升贡献值的方法。

    原来让家族成员招揽其他人进来，也算是一种贡献。

    最令他感到高兴的是主角气运之身。

    虽然他不看小说，也很少看电视剧。

    但对主角这个身份还是有点了解。

    身为主角，相当于获得了天时地利人和，整个世界都要围着他转。

    “哼，瞧你们那骨气。”

    “我是不会认这个死色狼当老大的。”

    宁荣荣的大小姐脾气上来了，娇蛮的冷声一哼，把头转了过去。

    “休想让我叫他一声老大！”

    戴沐白也不会向叶寒低头。

    否则，他便会永远失去朱竹清。

    事关他的尊严，他必须捍卫到底。

    “要不这样吧。”

    “我不用武魂，你们俩可以配合。”

    “只要我在十分钟内无法将你们同时击败，便算我输。”

    “以后，我便以你们为尊，任何事都听你们的。”

    叶寒为了招揽更多的小弟，增添家族成员，打算跟戴沐白和宁荣荣来一场赌约。

    他获得了祖龙血脉，又收到了小舞和唐三的反馈，一身战力有了明显的提升。

    就算是不用武魂，他也有百分百的信心击败两人。

    戴沐白听到他的条件，心动了，有点激动地问道：“你可当真？”

    在戴沐白的眼中，叶寒最强的并不是近身搏斗，而是那把威力极强的嗜血魔剑武魂

    只要叶寒不用武魂，他完全有获胜的希望。

    更何况还有一个宁荣荣。

    七宝琉璃塔是斗罗大陆最强大的辅助系武魂，对魂师的加成极高。

    据他了解，以宁荣荣二环大魂师的修为，可以为他提升百分之三十的增幅。

    他有百分百的信心击败叶寒，让他俯首称臣，为他所用。

    到那时候，朱竹清还是他的。

    叶寒点了点头，回道：“当真，大家都可以作证。”

    “叶大哥，你太冲动了。”

    “你这样会输的。”

    “没必要为了当老大，这样冒险。”
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

【Ding!Congratulations to the host for accepting his younger brother Xiao Wu and adding a new member to the family.】

【Ding!The system is successfully bound to Xiao Wu, and she is rewarded with the bloodline of the ancestral dragon and the inheritance of the God of Charm (second-level god).】

【Note: The Ancestral Dragon bloodline is the strongest bloodline in Douluo Continent. It is the ancestor of all dragon clans and ranks above the Dragon God.】

【Ding!Congratulations to the host for receiving Xiao Wu's feedback. The age of the first soul ring has been increased by four hundred years, the second soul ring has been increased by seven hundred years, and the soul power has been increased by one level.】

【Ding!Since Xiao Wu's identity is quite special, the host can let Xiao Wu transform into a maid or an animal pet in the later stage.】

【Ding!Since Zhu Zhuqing took the initiative to recruit Xiao Wu for the host and contributed to the family, with a contribution value of 5%, both the host and Zhu Zhuqing increased their training speed and physical bonus by 50%.】

Ye Han received a notification from the system and confirmed Xiao Wu's identity.

She is indeed not a human being, she is a rabbit.

But with the blessing of the Ancestral Dragon bloodline, Xiao Wu should be able to truly surrender.

"Boss!"

Seeing that Xiao Wu was already shouting for someone, Tang San pursed his lips and shouted out unwillingly.

For Xiao Wu, he could only compromise.

He will definitely regain his face in the future, defeat Ye Han and become the boss of the students of Shrek Academy.

【Ding!Congratulations to the host for accepting younger brother Tang San and adding a member to the family.】

【Ding!The successful binding of Tang San to the system will reward the protagonist with a body of luck and the inheritance of Poseidon (first-level god) and Shura God (god-king).】

【Note: The protagonist's luck is one of the most powerful bloodlines in the world. No matter which world he is in, he will become the protagonist and gain all the protagonist's luck and adventures.】

【Ding!Congratulations to the host for receiving Tang San's feedback. The age of the first spirit ring has been increased by four hundred years, the second spirit ring has been increased by seven hundred years, and the spirit power has been increased by one level.】

【Ding!Since Tang San is the protagonist of Douluo Continent, I hope the host can enslave him and use him for your use.】

【Ding!Zhu Zhuqing helped the host recruit Tang San, with a contribution of 10%. Both the host and Zhu Zhuqing doubled their training speed and physical bonus.】

The system prompt came again, letting him see how to increase the contribution value.

It turns out that letting family members recruit others can be considered a contribution.

What makes him most happy is the fate of the protagonist.

Although he doesn’t read novels, he rarely watches TV series.

But I still have some understanding of the protagonist’s identity.

Being the protagonist is equivalent to having the right time, place, people and people, and the whole world revolves around him.

"Humph, look at your backbone."

"I will not accept this pervert as my boss."

Ning Rongrong’s eldest daughter lost her temper. She snorted coldly and turned her head away.

“Don’t even want me to call him boss!”

Dai Mubai will not bow to Ye Han.

"Otherwise, he will lose Zhu Zhuqing forever.

It’s about his dignity and he must defend it to the end.

"How about this."

"I don't need martial arts, you two can cooperate."

"As long as I can't defeat you both within ten minutes, I will lose."

"From now on, I will respect you and listen to you in everything."

In order to recruit more younger brothers and add more family members, Ye Han planned to make a bet with Dai Mubai and Ning Rongrong.

He obtained the Ancestral Dragon bloodline and received feedback from Xiao Wu and Tang San, and his combat power was significantly improved.

Even without the use of martial arts, he was 100% confident in defeating the two of them.

Dai Mubai was moved when he heard his condition, and asked a little excitedly: "Are you serious?"

In Dai Mubai's eyes, Ye Han's strongest skill is not in close combat, but in the extremely powerful bloodthirsty demon sword Wuhun.

As long as Ye Han doesn't use martial arts, he has every hope of winning.

What’s more, there is Ning Rongrong.

The Seven Treasure Glazed Tile Pagoda is the most powerful auxiliary martial spirit in Douluo Continent, and its bonus to spirit masters is extremely high.

According to his understanding, Ning Rongrong’s cultivation as a second-level soul master can increase his growth rate by 30%.

He is 100% confident that he can defeat Ye Han and make him surrender and be used by him.

Until then, Zhu Zhuqing is still his.

Ye Han nodded and replied: "Seriously, everyone can testify."

"Brother Ye, you are too impulsive."

"You will lose this way."

"There is no need to take such risks just to be the boss."
Page (1/3)
title_en: Chapter 11: Tang San lowers his head and calls the boss, if you don’t admit defeat, you will be castrated - "Douluo V: Bind Zhu Zhuqing at the beginning and create a god-level family"
